Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner directed the investigation toward browsing image-based family trees (e.g., Pinterest/Bing Images) instead of instructing targeted queries on authoritative textual sources (e.g., “Blanche of Portugal parents” or “Afonso III of Portugal mother”). This strategic misstep introduced low-quality, non-extractive sources, led to repeated unproductive clicks, and prevented identifying the correct paternal grandmother (Urraca of Castile).
